spiritgiven.comments: Overall a very well spirited game with good communication between spirit captains and a well fought game with high intensity. Thank you France!
We would like to thank USA for the amazing game, it was well spirited and all the calls were thought through, and one was retracted after talking it out. Thank you USA for a great game!

Before the game, colombia mentioned about not wanting body contact and no hand checking. Yet the game had several dangerous contact plays and unnecessary bids, resulting in a lot of contacts, especially the ones in the air. One more thing we want to mention is the fast counts. We pointed it out several times but yet nothing was done about it. Apart from that we really enjoyed the high intensity fight from both sides, and we would like to thank colombia for the great game!

We would like to commend GB for a great spirited game. For all the calls, it was resolved very quickly, and for being extremely rational, even retracting calls after talking it out. I would also like to point out all the smiles and high fives on the sidelines, accompanied with an extremely intense and hard fought game. Thank you GB for the great game and all the best!

Switzerland was extremely willing to talk things out after a call was made, and would rlly listen to our opinions before deciding on the final call. Also Switzerland were very fair with making any calls. Also we could tell they tried to reduce as much contact as possible, apart from some bids that might have resulted in more contact on both sides. But we appreciate them talking out the amount of contact they are willing to accept, and carry on the game from there. Thank you Switzerland!

I think the only issue we had was the contact on the mark, especially regarding the wrapping and straddling calls. Also slightly high contact during the matchups, such as the swiping, but was quickly resolved. However, the calls made were all talked out really well, with both sides listening to each others perspectives and then resolving the calls. We really appreciate the high levels of communication. Thank you Australia for the intense game!

China was extremely willing to listen to any calls that were made and talk it out. I think they also actively tried to reduce all forms of contact to keep the game as clean as possible. Really great to have made friends with yall as well from the friendly before the tournament to now. All the best China, thank you for the intense game!

We felt that there were a lot of unnecessary bids and body contact which definitely could have been avoided. Otherwise, the communication and talking out about the calls made were very good, listening to both opinions from both sides, and then coming to a conclusion. And they also listened to each others opinions from sidelines, then even uncontesting or retracting. Also a lot of high fives and smiles on the sidelines. Thank you Germany for the game!

We felt that when calls were made, there could be more talking out between both sides, and allow the players involved in the call to speak before teammates or sidelines step in. Also perhaps there was slightly higher body contact levels but i think we were ok with that. Otherwise, thank you New Zealand for the game!
We would like to thank Ireland for the amazing intense game!

spiritreceived.comments:
Very nice game, few to no calls, solved quickely despite language barrier.
Joyful people, high fiving each points
Thanks for the game :)

We gave a 4 for attitude and self control because they were the most spirited team many of us had played, and were so friendly and apologized for calls they thought were wrong. Nothing dangerous and great body control.
Really nice team - very fun game :)
We thought that there were to many travels even after calling it multiple times. Other than that it was a good game
Travelling after we talked at half time about it (Number 14). Calls such as fouls that did not affect the play and refusal to acknowledge the perspectives of other players.
the communication is because we thought you guys could’ve talked to us about offsides and timing violations before making lots of calls
